§ 01 · The Program

Real customers,
real decisions.

From managing store operations and handling stock shortages, to launching new product lines, coordinating omnichannel strategy, and leading digital transformation, every scenario drops you into a genuine retail situation and asks one question: what should you actually do? Sixty-eight foundations-focused scenarios and thirty-two strategy-and-expansion-focused scenarios, covered systematically, one real decision at a time.

01

Built for real retail judgment

Every scenario mirrors an actual situation a retail or e-commerce professional faces — never abstract, never artificial.

02

Systematic, complete coverage

A full set of 100 scenarios across store operations, e-commerce, customer experience, fulfillment, and retail growth.

03

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with clear, encouraging feedback after every exercise.

04

Genuine decision-making practice

Real situations with one best-practice response and three realistic missteps — not vocabulary drills, but sound retail judgment under real pressure.

§ 02 · 100 Scenarios

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Business English & Retail Coach

Brice Gadou is a business English specialist dedicated to helping retail and e-commerce professionals think clearly under pressure in a second language. Mr. Gad reflects his belief that real fluency in retail isn't reciting phrases — it's reading a situation correctly and choosing the right response, in the moment.

Designed for B1–B2 learners who already work in, or aspire to work in, retail and e-commerce roles in English — Mr. Gad Retail, E-commerce & Consumer Business is more than a language course. It's a working rehearsal for the retail moments you'll actually face.
